description: This PHP class, EssUserRole, represents a user role within the OrangeHRM system's authorization module for Employee Self Service (ESS). It provides methods to retrieve accessible entity IDs related to performance reviews, performance trackers, and logs based on user permissions, as well as quick launch items.

classes.name: EssUserRole
classes.description: A class managing user permissions and access levels for Employee Self Service processes, particularly focusing on performance reviews, trackers, and quick launch features.

methods.name: getAccessibleIdsForEntity
methods.description: Retrieves accessible entity IDs for a given entity type, based on user permissions.

methods.name: getAccessibleReviewIds
methods.description: Returns review IDs associated with the employee, filtered by allowed statuses if provided.

methods.name: getAccessiblePerformanceTrackerIdsForESS
methods.description: Returns performance tracker IDs accessible to the employee.

methods.name: getAccessiblePerformanceTrackerLogIdsForESS
methods.description: Returns performance tracker log IDs associated with the user.

methods.name: getAccessibleQuickLaunchList
methods.description: Fetches quick launch options available to the user in ESS.
